name: Donald Trump
description: Follow Donald Trump, a tracked person, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: The Trump Administration and the Shrinking Number of Women in Top Roles
changes.summary: In President Trump’s second term, those heading for the exits, voluntarily or involuntarily, are female officials.

changes.title: Inflation Data Shows Prices Are Up, Worrying Republicans Ahead of the Midterms
changes.summary: The newest inflation report gave Democrats a chance to tie pain at the pump to President Trump’s decisions.

changes.title: Trump invokes executive privilege in Kennedy Center legal fight
changes.summary: President Trump has formally invoked executive privilege to shield certain records from a Democratic congresswoman who sits on the Kennedy Center board.

changes.title: Trump says execution of Fort Hood shooter will not be livestreamed
changes.summary: President Trump announced that the firing squad execution of Fort Hood shooter Nidal Hasan will not be livestreamed, overriding Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth’s earlier claim that it would be. NBC News' Monica Alba reports the latest details from the White House.

changes.title: Trump Brushes off Inflation Jump on Midterm Campaign Trail
changes.summary: A new jump in inflation is putting the issue of affordability front-and-center in key midterm races across the country that will decide Washington’s balance of power. President Donald Trump was back on the campaign trail on Wednesday, brushing off those concerns. NBC’s Monica Alba reports for TODAY.

changes.title: Morning news brief
changes.summary: Trump's campaign tour continues as Republicans rally voters ahead of midterms, Ukraine faces limited access to Starshield technology, Houthi rebels hit Saudi oil company building.

changes.title: These swing voters regret voting for Trump and it's influencing their midterm choices
changes.summary: Some key voters in Georgia say deep frustration and disappointment with President Trump are motivating their election plans just weeks before Election Day. (Image credit: Megan Varner).

changes.title: Trump cancels public execution, but a line may already have been crossed
changes.summary: Defense Secretary Hegseth's announcement of a livestreamed execution elicited reactions of disgust and condemnation from some faith leaders and politicians. But within his church, it's not an outlier. (Image credit: Jim Watson).

changes.title: Ukraine resumes attacks on Russian oil refineries as relations with Trump sour
changes.summary: Ukrainian drones attacked a refinery in Russia's Ryazan region early Thursday, hours after Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said that a brief truce spurned by Moscow was over amid deepening tensions with Washington.

changes.title: ‘The valley has been left behind’: how one of California’s poorest areas became its toughest political battleground
changes.summary: Rising costs and threatened healthcare benefits are testing voters’ loyalty to Trump as Democrat Randy Villegas challenges David Valadao Vanessa Martinez used to work two jobs to make ends meet. Now she works three. In another era, the 26-year-old from California’s hardscrabble Central valley could have been a poster c.
